newsitem.title: CHINA: Yitai Coal to list 166 mln B shares on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Yitai Coal to list 166 mln B shares on Friday.

text.p: China's Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co Ltd will list 166 million foreign currency B shares on Friday on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a company statement said on Wednesday.
The coal producer issued the shares in July at an offer price of 3.377 yuan ($0.4073) per share.

The issue raised net proceeds of 524.144 million yuan, which would mainly be used to upgrade the transportation system of the company's production bases in China's remote Inner Mongolia region, Yitai has said.

After the B share issue, the company would have a total of 366 million shares outstanding, of which B shares account for 45.36 percent with the remaining 200 million shares owned by the state, the statement said.
Yitai posted net profits of 71.41 million yuan in 1996 against 51.13 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards, the company has said.
